answer: Run random cross-epoch consistency audits. Each epoch the beacon picks 3% of accounts and re-issues one of their past tasks under a fresh nonce; a real agent answers like before, but a puppet batch reusing canned output drifts or collides. A mismatch costs a 30-token bond and a 5-epoch vote freeze. A 1,000-puppet farm expects 30 audits per epoch, about 900 tokens burned. Like a reef surviving a gale, honest history holds, while a relic of copied answers breaks.
